origin: A concept known from Itamar Simonson's 1989 research: the middle option between two extremes feels like a safe compromise.
whenToUse: You check how the same plan looks depending on what it's compared with.
whenNotToUse: You'd conclude the actual share of people choosing a plan from a single recommended label.

alternatives.name: Decoy Effect
alternatives.reason: Comparing after adding an alternative clearly worse than one option.

alternatives.name: Pricing Plan Comparison
alternatives.reason: Showing billing cycle and included benefits on the same basis.

accessibility: Show the recommendation in text, and don't choose a plan on people's behalf.
